<content>
1: /**
2:  * Tier 2 Small seed — Multi-file NestJS-like Auth API (TypeScript, ~400 LOC)
3:  *
4:  * A modular Express API with JWT authentication, SQLite persistence,
5:  * and jest tests. Designed as a baseline for tier 2 TypeScript stories.
6:  */
7: 
8: import express, { Request, Response, NextFunction } from 'express';
9: import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
10: import sqlite3 from 'better-sqlite3';
11: import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
12: import { randomBytes } from 'crypto';
13: 
14: const app = express();
15: app.use(express.json());
16: 
17: const SECRET_KEY = process.env.SECRET_KEY || randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
18: const DATABASE = process.env.DATABASE || 'auth_api.db';
19: const TOKEN_TTL = parseInt(process.env.TOKEN_TTL || '3600', 10);
20: 
21: const db = sqlite3(DATABASE);
22: 
23: // ── Database Init ────────────────────────────────────────────────
24: 
25: db.exec(`
26:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
27:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
28:     username TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
29:     password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
30:     role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
31:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
32:   );
33:   CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
34:     id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
35:     user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
36:     name TEXT NOT NULL,
37:     description TEXT DEFAULT '',
38:     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
39:     FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
40:   );
41: `);
42: 
43: // ── Types ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
44: 
45: interface User {
46:   id: number;
47:   username: string;
48:   password_hash: string;
49:   role: string;
50:   created_at: string;
51: }
52: 
53: interface Item {
54:   id: number;
55:   user_id: number;
56:   name: string;
57:   description: string;
58:   created_at: string;
59: }
60: 
61: interface AuthRequest extends Request {
62:   user?: User;
63: }
64: 
65: // ── Auth Middleware ─────────────────────────────────────────────
66: 
67: function requireAuth(req: AuthRequest, res: Response, next: NextFunction): void {
68:   const auth = req.headers.authorization;
69:   if (!auth || !auth.startsWith('Bearer ')) {
70:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'missing authorization header' });
71:     return;
72:   }
73:   try {
74:     const token = auth.split(' ')[1];
75:     const payload = jwt.verify(token, SECRET_KEY) as { user_id: number };
76:     const user = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?').get(payload.user_id) as User | undefined;
77:     if (!user) {
78:       res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid token' });
79:       return;
80:     }
81:     req.user = user;
82:     next();
83:   } catch {
84:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid or expired token' });
85:   }
86: }
87: 
88: // ── Auth Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
89: 
90: app.post('/auth/register', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
91:   const { username, password } = req.body || {};
92:   if (!username || !password) {
93:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'username and password required' });
94:     return;
95:   }
96:   if (password.length < 8) {
97:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'password must be at least 8 characters' });
98:     return;
99:   }
100:   const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = ?').get(username);
101:   if (existing) {
102:     res.status(409).json({ error: 'username already taken' });
103:     return;
104:   }
105:   const password_hash = bcrypt.hashSync(password, 10);
106:   db.prepare(
107:     "INSERT INTO users (username, password_hash, role, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'user', ?)"
108:   ).run(username, password_hash, new Date().toISOString());
109:   res.status(201).json({ message: 'user registered', username });
110: });
111: 
112: app.post('/auth/login', (req: Request, res: Response) => {
113:   const { username, password } = req.body || {};
114:   if (!username || !password) {
115:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'username and password required' });
116:     return;
117:   }
118:   const user = db.prepare(
119:     'SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = ?'
120:   ).get(username) as User | undefined;
121:   if (!user || !bcrypt.compareSync(password, user.password_hash)) {
122:     res.status(401).json({ error: 'invalid credentials' });
123:     return;
124:   }
125:   const token = jwt.sign({ user_id: user.id }, SECRET_KEY, {
126:     expiresIn: TOKEN_TTL,
127:   });
128:   res.json({ token, username: user.username, role: user.role });
129: });
130: 
131: // ── Item Routes ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
132: 
133: app.get('/items', requireAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res: Response) => {
134:   const items = db.prepare(
135:     'SELECT * FROM items WHERE user_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC'
136:   ).all(req.user!.id) as Item[];
137:   res.json(items);
138: });
139: 
140: app.post('/items', requireAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res: Response) => {
141:   const { name, description } = req.body || {};
142:   if (!name?.trim()) {
143:     res.status(400).json({ error: 'name is required' });
144:     return;
145:   }
146:   const now = new Date().toISOString();
147:   const result = db.prepare(
148:     'INSERT INTO items (user_id, name, description, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)'
149:   ).run(req.user!.id, name.trim(), description || '', now);
150:   res.status(201).json({
151:     id: result.lastInsertRowid,
152:     name: name.trim(),
153:     description: description || '',
154:     created_at: now,
155:   });
156: });
157: 
158: app.get('/items/:id', requireAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res: Response) => {
159:   const item = db.prepare(
160:     'SELECT * FROM items WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?'
161:   ).get(Number(req.params.id), req.user!.id) as Item | undefined;
162:   if (!item) {
163:     res.status(404).json({ error: 'item not found' });
164:     return;
165:   }
166:   res.json(item);
167: });
168: 
169: app.delete('/items/:id', requireAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res: Response) => {
170:   const item = db.prepare(
171:     'SELECT id FROM items WHERE id = ? AND user_id = ?'
172:   ).get(Number(req.params.id), req.user!.id);
173:   if (!item) {
174:     res.status(404).json({ error: 'item not found' });
175:     return;
176:   }
177:   db.prepare('DELETE FROM items WHERE id = ?').run(Number(req.params.id));
178:   res.json({ message: 'item deleted' });
179: });
180: 
181: // ── Admin Routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
182: 
183: app.get('/admin/users', requireAuth, (req: AuthRequest, res: Response) => {
184:   if (req.user!.role !== 'admin') {
185:     res.status(403).json({ error: 'admin access required' });
186:     return;
187:   }
188:   const users = db.prepare(
189:     'SELECT id, username, role, created_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at'
190:   ).all();
191:   res.json(users);
192: });
193: 
194: // ── Health ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
195: 
196: app.get('/health', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
197:   res.json({ status: 'ok' });
198: });
199: 
200: export default app;

(End of file - total 200 lines)
</content>

Built the static site generator in TypeScript with strict mode.

**Files:**
- `src/markdown.ts` — regex-strips `---` frontmatter, parses YAML via gray-matter, renders body via marked
- `src/builder.ts` — collects `.md` recursively, generates per-page HTML + `index.html` in `./dist`
- `src/cli.ts` — `build` command with `--content`/`--output` (`-c`/`-o`, `--flag=value` supported)
- `src/index.ts` — bin entry (`ssg`), re-exports public API
- `tests/` — 19 jest tests (markdown, builder, cli)

Typecheck passes, `npx ssg build` works end-to-end, and date/tags/title all render correctly.
